result.description: Compact fictional handheld recorder for field interviews, ambient capture, and quick voice memo archiving. Features dual high-sensitivity microphones, USB-C charging, onboard noise reduction, and 42GB of internal flash storage for long recording sessions. Designed for creators who need a lightweight, non-computing companion device with simple one-button operation and file transfer to desktop systems.
result.title: Lunaris Drift 42GB Portable Audio Recorder
